card.name: Words just before 'intact' or 'undamaged'
card.fires_on: The word 'are' in 'container and seals are intact' in use-only-if-clear instructions. It also fires on words right before 'intact' or 'undamaged' skin.

modes.label: Container seals are intact
modes.description: The verb 'are' after 'container and seals' in inspection instructions for injection solutions.
modes.example: Use only if solution is clear and container and seals<< are>> intact.

modes.label: Before intact or undamaged skin
modes.description: A bracket or adjective just before a word like 'intact' or 'undamaged' describing skin.
modes.example: Use Xiclofen TM Ointment only on dry, intact<< (>>unbroken) skin.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words starting with 'un' (und, unf, unde), as in 'undamaged'.
